beats.say: After six years of silence, K/DA have teased 20 October.
A teaser poster on K/DA's official X account points to that date, Insider Gaming and Inven Global report.
Their last release was the ALL OUT EP, back in 2020.
K/DA are four League of Legends champions: Ahri, Akali, Evelynn and Kai'Sa.
They debuted with Pop/Stars at the 2018 World Championship final.

shots.src: commons-search:League of Legends World Championship 2018 Incheon

beats.say: The song's name isn't confirmed. The poster says Start a Fire, and fans spotted a registration for a track called Watch Me.
So which K/DA song is your favourite?
